name: more-vertical
description: Three evenly spaced vertical dots for more actions in a circle frame.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Three identical centered dots. Horizontal Outline circle centers are (7.5,12), (12,12) and (16.5,12), each radius 1 at Regular 1.75. Vertical is the rigid 90-degree rotation, with centers (12,7.5), (12,12) and (12,16.5), retaining the same size. Natural Filled dots use radius 1.875, exactly matching the visible Regular Outline exterior. The tiny radius-0.125 Outline interior counter is intentional; Filled removes it. No added unframed box. Regular visible bounds are 12.75 by 3.75 for Horizontal, swapped for Vertical, centered at 12,12. Thin 1.25 and Bold 2.50 retain the radius-1 centerlines. At Bold, the Circle frame still has 1.125px radial clearance. None/Square/Circle reuse the same glyph position and size. Standard frame exteriors span 2..22, with Square radius 4 and Circle radius 10. Outline frame centerlines span 2.875..21.125 with Square corner radius 3.125 and Circle radius 9.125. Framed Filled subtracts the exact three solid Filled circles as transparent negative space. All new forms are drafts pending owner review; existing artwork is unchanged.

review.note: Owner approved every current static icon, style and supported frame on 2026-10-27. Motion approval is separate.

reviewHistory.note: New ellipsis icon and frame variants; awaits owner review.
